entries.title: Exodus 21:1
segments: ¶"Now these [are] the judgments which you shall set before them:

entries.title: Exodus 21:2
segments: "If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years; and in the seventh he shall go out free and pay nothing.

entries.title: Exodus 21:3
segments: "If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself; if he [comes in] married, then his wife shall go out with him.

entries.title: Exodus 21:4
segments: "If his master has given him a wife, and she has borne him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.

entries.title: Exodus 21:5
segments: "But if the servant plainly says, 'I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free,'

entries.title: Exodus 21:6
segments: "then his master shall bring him to the judges. He shall also bring him to the door, or to the doorpost, and his master shall pierce his ear with an awl; and he shall serve him forever.

entries.title: Exodus 21:7
segments: "And if a man sells his daughter to be a female slave, she shall not go out as the male slaves do.

entries.title: Exodus 21:8
segments: "If she does not please her master, who has betrothed her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

entries.title: Exodus 21:9
segments: "And if he has betrothed her to his son, he shall deal with her according to the custom of daughters.

entries.title: Exodus 21:10
segments: "If he takes another [wife], he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marriage rights.

entries.title: Exodus 21:11
segments: "And if he does not do these three for her, then she shall go out free, without [paying] money.

entries.title: Exodus 21:12
segments: ¶"He who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:13
segments: "However, if he did not lie in wait, but God delivered [him] into his hand, then I will appoint for you a place where he may flee.

entries.title: Exodus 21:14
segments: "But if a man acts with premeditation against his neighbor, to kill him by treachery, you shall take him from My altar, that he may die.

entries.title: Exodus 21:15
segments: "And he who strikes his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:16
segments: "He who kidnaps a man and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:17
segments: "And he who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:18
segments: "If men contend with each other, and one strikes the other with a stone or with [his] fist, and he does not die but is confined to [his] bed,

entries.title: Exodus 21:19
segments: "if he rises again and walks about outside with his staff, then he who struck [him] shall be acquitted. He shall only pay [for] the loss of his time, and shall provide [for him] to be thoroughly healed.

entries.title: Exodus 21:20
segments: "And if a man beats his male or female servant with a rod, so that he dies under his hand, he shall surely be punished.

entries.title: Exodus 21:21
segments: "Notwithstanding, if he remains alive a day or two, he shall not be punished; for he [is] his property.

entries.title: Exodus 21:22
segments: ¶"If men fight, and hurt a woman with child, so that she gives birth prematurely, yet no harm follows, he shall surely be punished accordingly as the woman's husband imposes on him; and he shall pay as the judges [determine].

entries.title: Exodus 21:23
segments: "But if [any] harm follows, then you shall give life for life,

entries.title: Exodus 21:24
segments: "eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

entries.title: Exodus 21:25
segments: "burn for burn, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

entries.title: Exodus 21:26
segments: "If a man strikes the eye of his male or female servant, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for the sake of his eye.

entries.title: Exodus 21:27
segments: "And if he knocks out the tooth of his male or female servant, he shall let him go free for the sake of his tooth.

entries.title: Exodus 21:28
segments: "If an ox gores a man or a woman to death, then the ox shall surely be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox [shall be] acquitted.

entries.title: Exodus 21:29
segments: "But if the ox tended to thrust with its horn in times past, and it has been made known to his owner, and he has not kept it confined, so that it has killed a man or a woman, the ox shall be stoned and its owner also shall be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 21:30
segments: "If there is imposed on him a sum of money, then he shall pay to redeem his life, whatever is imposed on him.

entries.title: Exodus 21:31
segments: "Whether it has gored a son or gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

entries.title: Exodus 21:32
segments: "If the ox gores a male or female servant, he shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

entries.title: Exodus 21:33
segments: "And if a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and does not cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls in it,

entries.title: Exodus 21:34
segments: "the owner of the pit shall make [it] good; he shall give money to their owner, but the dead [animal] shall be his.

entries.title: Exodus 21:35
segments: "If one man's ox hurts another's, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live ox and divide the money from it; and the dead [ox] they shall also divide.

entries.title: Exodus 21:36
segments: "Or if it was known that the ox tended to thrust in time past, and its owner has not kept it confined, he shall surely pay ox for ox, and the dead animal shall be his own.
